name: MagicBot
summary: The humanoid line from Chinese firm MagicLab, which makes over 90% of its key hardware in-house — joint modules, reducers and dexterous hands — and runs a dual-mode architecture splitting slow task planning from real-time motion control. MagicBot has been shown doing factory-style handling and coordinated multi-robot demos.

sources.title: Top 20 China Humanoid Robot Companies to Know in 2026 — CNCPioneer
